Outside code and documentation contributions are currently closed.
Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request.
Bug reports and suggestions belong in issues, using fictional reproductions;
security reports follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

The fields below are for changes already coordinated with the maintainers.
This template does not adopt contributor terms or grant a separate commercial licence.

## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, the change and its effect on the person using it.

## Verification

State what was actually checked, on which revision, and any remaining limits.
Include the result of `bin/check` where applicable.

## Source and documentation

Identify any reused third-party code or assets and their terms. For original
work, state that it is original. Link related model/setup/documentation changes.
Keep real member data, credentials and production captures out of the change.
